landing.heading: Free score calculator for Forest Shuffle
landing.intro: Forest Shuffle Scorer adds up your forest at the end of the game. Pick the trees, animals, plants and mushrooms in your play area and the app applies every card effect and synergy for you. No more counting by hand, no more scoring mistakes.
features: Scores the base game with Alpine, Woodland Edge and Exploration, Forest Shuffle: Dartmoor with Exmoor, and Forest Shuffle: Smoky Mountains
Works offline and installs on your phone like a native app
Keeps your game history with player stats, rankings and a worldwide Hall of Fame
Live scoring: every player enters their own forest on their own phone
Free, no ads, no account required, available in 18 languages

faq.a: There is no single formula: every card scores by the condition printed on it. Some trees pay a flat amount per copy, like Douglas Fir at 5 points each. Others only pay once you reach a threshold, so Beech scores nothing below four copies and Oak needs eight different tree species, while Sycamore grows with the size of your forest. Animals and plants count what surrounds them, such as tree species, symbols or copies of another card, and most mushrooms give an effect during the game instead of points. Every card in your cave is worth one point, and cards left in your hand score nothing. The app knows each card’s rule and applies it for you.

faq.q: Which editions and expansions does the scorer support?
faq.a: Forest Shuffle with the Alpine, Woodland Edge and Exploration expansions, Forest Shuffle: Dartmoor with the Exmoor expansion, and Forest Shuffle: Smoky Mountains. New cards are added as they are released.

faq.q: What is a good score in Forest Shuffle?
faq.a: That depends on the player count and the expansions in play. The Hall of Fame shows the current records and how your best score compares with all recorded games.

faq.q: Do I need an account or an internet connection?
faq.a: No. The app works offline and stores your games on your device. You can optionally sign in with your e-mail address to keep your history across devices.
Yes. Forest Shuffle Scorer is available on Google Play, and the web version runs in any browser on iPhone, Android and desktop.

smokyPage.heading: Forest Shuffle: Smoky Mountains score calculator
smokyPage.intro: Forest Shuffle: Smoky Mountains is the stand-alone Forest Shuffle game set in the Great Smoky Mountains, with river terrain cards next to your trees. This free scoring app adds up your forest at the end of the game: pick the trees, animals and plants you played, and the app applies each card’s scoring rule for you.
features: The full Smoky Mountains deck, scored by the rules in the published rulebook and appendix
Rivers and the cave are counted together with the rest of your forest
2 to 5 players, plus live scoring where everyone enters their own forest on their own phone
Game history, player stats and a worldwide Hall of Fame for Smoky Mountains games
Free, no ads, no account required, works offline

faq.q: How do you score Forest Shuffle: Smoky Mountains?
faq.a: As in the other Forest Shuffle games, every card scores by the condition printed on it. Trees, animals and plants count what surrounds them, such as tree species, symbols or copies of other cards, and the river terrain cards add a second kind of habitat that some cards score with. Every card in your cave is worth one point, and cards left in your hand score nothing. The app knows each card’s rule and adds everything up.

faq.q: Can I combine Smoky Mountains with Forest Shuffle or its expansions?
faq.a: No. Smoky Mountains is a stand-alone game and cannot be combined with Forest Shuffle, its expansions or its spin-offs. Choose the Smoky Mountains edition in the app and it shows only its own cards.

faq.q: Is the Smoky Mountains scorer free?
faq.a: Yes. It is free, has no ads and needs no account. It runs in any browser, works offline once loaded, and is also available as an Android app on Google Play.

faq.q: A card scored differently from my game. What now?
faq.a: The card rules come from the published English rulebook and appendix. If a card scores differently from your copy of the game, send feedback from the settings page and it will be corrected.

This free scoring app adds up your forest at the end of the game, with or without the Exmoor expansion: pick the cards you played and the app applies each card’s scoring rule for you.
features: Every Dartmoor card, scored by the rules in the published rulebook and appendix
The Exmoor expansion with its new cards and its own caves
Moors, trees and shrubs and the cave are counted together with the rest of your forest
Live scoring where everyone enters their own forest on their own phone, plus game history and player stats
Free, no ads, no account required, works offline

faq.q: How do you score Forest Shuffle: Dartmoor?
faq.a: As in the original Forest Shuffle, every card scores by the condition printed on it. Trees and shrubs, animals and plants count what surrounds them, such as tree species, symbols or copies of other cards, and the moor cards add a second landscape that some cards score with. Every card in your cave is worth one point, and cards left in your hand score nothing. The app knows each card’s rule and adds everything up.

faq.q: Does the app support the Exmoor expansion?
faq.a: Yes. Switch on Exmoor when you start a Dartmoor game and its cards appear in the scoring wizard. With Exmoor, its own caves replace the Dartmoor caves, and the app scores them accordingly.

expansionsPage.heading: Score calculator for the Forest Shuffle expansions
expansionsPage.intro: Forest Shuffle grows with every expansion: Alpine brings mountain trees and animals, Woodland Edge adds the species of the forest edge, and Exploration brings rare species and special caves. This free scoring app counts your forest with any mix of them: switch on the expansions you play with, pick the cards in your forest and the app applies each card’s scoring rule for you.
features: Alpine, Woodland Edge and Exploration, alone or in any combination
Every card scored by the rules in the published rulebooks and appendix
Exploration’s special caves are scored instead of the base caves
Live scoring where everyone enters their own forest on their own phone, plus game history and player stats
Free, no ads, no account required, works offline

faq.q: Which Forest Shuffle expansions does the scorer support?
faq.a: Alpine, Woodland Edge and Exploration for the original Forest Shuffle, alone or in any combination. Forest Shuffle: Dartmoor with Exmoor and Forest Shuffle: Smoky Mountains have their own editions in the app.

faq.q: How do I score a game with expansions?
faq.a: Switch on the expansions you play with when you start a new game. Their cards then appear in the scoring wizard next to the base game cards. Pick what is in each player’s forest and the app applies every card’s rule, including cards that count cards from other expansions.

faq.q: How do the Exploration caves score?
faq.a: Exploration’s special caves replace the base caves, and each player picks one. Every special cave scores in its own way: choose the cave a player took in the scoring wizard and the app applies its rule.
Yes. It is free, has no ads and needs no account. It runs in any browser, works offline once loaded, and is also available as an Android app on Google Play.
